program='''def transform(grid):
    colors = {c for row in grid for c in row if c != 7}
    def components(color):
        points = {(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,x in enumerate(row) if x == color}
        left = set(points); count = 0
        while left:
            count += 1; stack = [left.pop()]
            while stack:
                r,c = stack.pop()
                near = {(rr,cc) for rr,cc in left if abs(rr-r)<=1 and abs(cc-c)<=1}
                left -= near; stack.extend(near)
        return count
    color = max(colors, key=components)
    points = [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,x in enumerate(row) if x == color]
    out = [[7 for _ in row] for row in grid]
    r0 = min(r for r,c in points); r1 = max(r for r,c in points)
    c0 = min(c for r,c in points); c1 = max(c for r,c in points)
    main = sum((r-r0)==(c-c0) for r,c in points)
    anti = sum((r-r0)==(c1-c) for r,c in points)
    for k in range(min(r1-r0,c1-c0)+1):
        r,c = (r0+k,c0+k) if main >= anti else (r0+k,c1-k)
        out[r][c] = color
    return out
'''
